classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the square-root domain, eliminate the parameter and sketch the resulting restricted line.

children.label: a
children.prompt: State the possible values of $x$ and $y$.

answer.worked: Real coordinates require $t\ge0$. Thus $\sqrt{t}\ge0$, so $x\ge0$ and $y=4-\sqrt{t}\le4$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the Cartesian equation of the curve.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Sketch the graph of the curve.

answer.short: Ray on $y=4-x$, starting at the included endpoint $(0,4)$ and passing through $(4,0)$.
answer.worked: At $t=0$, $(x,y)=(0,4)$; at $t=16$, $(x,y)=(4,0)$. Since $x\ge0$, draw the ray from the included endpoint $(0,4)$ towards the lower right.

spec.description: Restricted straight-line ray with a closed endpoint at (0,4), crossing (4,0), and continuing towards the lower right.
